_comment: Pinned baseline for scripts/run_projected_test_suites.py. Every count here was MEASURED on one host and one toolchain, not derived analytically -- treat them as host-dependent facts to be re-verified, not universal truths. `tests` and `failures` are gating: the run must match both exactly (higher OR lower than recorded is a FAIL -- see the module docstring for why). `skipped` is informational only; the gate records and displays it but never fails on a skipped-count mismatch, because XCTest's own skip conditions (platform/build-flag guards inside the projected sources) can legitimately vary the skip count without indicating a defect in this gate. `swift_testing` pins the SEPARATE Swift Testing (`@Test`) leg for the same target -- `tests` and `failures` are both gating, in either direction, exactly like the XCTest fields; 0 is a real, checked pin (see the module docstring's zero-case vacuity trap), not an absence of coverage. To regenerate after an intentional change to the projected suites: run `python3 scripts/run_projected_test_suites.py --update-expectations`, read the printed warning, diff this file against the previous commit, and only commit the diff after confirming each changed number by hand -- this command RECORDS whatever the run currently produced, it does not validate that the new numbers are correct.

_provenance.method: python3 scripts/export_public_repository.py --development-projection (967 files); each target built individually and its .xctest bundle run directly via this gate (scripts/run_projected_test_suites.py). The 2565-test / 75-failure predecessor baseline had been corroborated three independent ways (swift test --filter, direct xcrun xctest, and this gate), all agreeing. This re-baseline is the same gate re-run after an exclusion change; the gate CORRECTLY reported MISMATCH against the old baseline first (a drop in failures fails too, by design), and these numbers are what it then measured. Total: 2519 tests, 0 failures across all 8 targets.
_provenance.scope: The 8 MLX-free projected test targets only. SpikeCoreTests, FastMLXHarnessTests, ExactPrefixMLXTests, SpikeServingAdaptersTests (MLX/Metal targets) and the vendored MLXLMTests package are not covered here.
_provenance._amendments: 2026-09-21 (cycle 128): ServingCoreTests 721 -> 726. NOT a re-baseline -- one target, one number, hand-confirmed rather than regenerated. The delta is exactly the 5 test methods added to OpenAIChatCompletionsTests.swift for the add_generation_prompt / continue_final_message split (4 covering the honored add_generation_prompt field, 1 covering the continue_final_message 400). Reconciled three ways before editing: counting the added `func test` methods in the diff (5), a local `swift test --filter ServingCoreTests` run (726), and the CI gate's own measurement on the failing run 35628846476 (726, expected 721). `skipped` stays 2 and every other target is untouched. 2026-09-21 (cycle 129): ServingCoreTests 726 -> 735. Again one target, one number, hand-confirmed rather than regenerated. The delta is exactly the 9 test methods added to OpenAIChatCompletionsTests.swift for the chat_template_kwargs allowlist-forward + visible-drop fix. Reconciled two ways before editing (a third, CI's own measurement, is not available pre-publish): counting added `func test` methods in the diff (+9, 0 removed) and a local `swift test --package-path spike --filter ServingCoreTests` run measuring 735 with 2 skipped and 0 failures. Moved in the SAME increment as the tests, which is the lesson cycle 128 paid for: every local gate in the cycle contract is blind to this file, so a green dev suite does not imply a green public gate. The 2026-09-17 provenance above still describes how the other seven targets' numbers were obtained.

HarnessCoreTests.note: Re-baselined 2026-09-17 after the projected suite was made green. Was 1307 tests / 75 failures: 47 projected cases depended on assets the projection does not ship, so they are now excluded from the public projection. One new case was added in their place, pinning a refusal branch that the exclusion made newly reachable to test with only projected assets. Net -46 = -47 excluded +1 new. MEASURED by this gate, not derived. 2026-09-19: +9 residency-admission cases in QualityAdmissionTests (31 -> 40 test methods by source count); public CI run 35425151339 MEASURED 1270 tests, 0 failures, before this pin moved.

swift_testing.note: Four Swift Testing suites this gate's XCTest leg never ran: ForcedScoringPlanTests (7), SystemProfileOperatorBudgetTests (23), TailStatisticTests (10), WiredCeilingOvercommitGuardTests (9). MEASURED via `swift test --disable-xctest --filter '^HarnessCoreTests\.'` on both Swift 6.3.3 and Swift 6.4.
